title: GIS Developer
summary: A GIS (geographic information system) developer builds software that stores, analyses and shows location data, such as web maps for utilities, telecom networks, city planning or land records. You sit in an engineering or geospatial team, connecting spatial databases and map servers to web apps that field staff and planners use.
dailyDuties: Build web map screens with layers, search and editing tools
Write spatial queries and tune PostGIS tables
Publish and update map services on ArcGIS Server or GeoServer
Automate data processing with Python and ArcPy scripts
Load and clean survey, satellite and CAD data
Fix map display and performance issues reported by users

skills.expectation: Work with ArcGIS or QGIS and publish map services with ArcGIS Server or GeoServer
Store spatial data in PostGIS and write fast spatial queries
Build web maps with Leaflet, OpenLayers or the ArcGIS Maps SDK
Automate geoprocessing with Python, ArcPy or GeoPandas
Build the app front end in a modern framework
Build the app front end in a modern framework
Consume and build REST APIs, including ArcGIS REST and OGC services
Build spatial APIs with Django or FastAPI
Load and convert spatial data between formats

certifications.why: Esri's entry developer exam covers the ArcGIS platform and APIs that most Indian GIS postings use.
Proves web map development with Esri's JavaScript SDK.
